# Source Code Repositories
This file system directory is where source code repositories from outside this code repository that are used by the product or the process will be stored.

Each released source code repository will have a separate directory with the following conventions:
- level 1 directories are for the DNS domain name for the repository API server
- level 2 directories are for the reference names used by the API server for the owner of the repositories
- level 3 directories are for the reference names used by the API server for the source code repositories
- all names are in lower-snake case
